messages.author: 074a030d0cd7e490
messages.subject: multi-species dynamic n-mixture ?
parts: Hi, I am searching the internet and this group for information about dynamic n-mixture models for more than one species. I am finding information about 'dynamic n-mixture' and 'community n-mixture' models, but nothing about 'dynamic n-mixture community' models. Has anyone done such a model? Is there a good reason not to try? Thank you!

messages.author: 589aec0ddd98c191
messages.subject: Re: multi-species dynamic n-mixture ?
parts:
Hi Gonçalo,

We have a new paper on "multi-species dynamic N-occupancy model" which uses detection-non detection data to estimate demographic rates and abundance for multiple species (with simulations and an antelope community): https://conbio.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/cobi.13934

A dynamic n-mixture community model makes conceptual sense to me but perhaps the limiting factor is available data on multi-species that would meet the assumptions of the model... ??  

Elise

messages.subject: AW: multi-species dynamic n-mixture ?
parts:
Dear Gonçalo,

 

the model you’re interested in could be called a community version of the famous Dail-Madsen model. Would be very straightforward to build in (e.g.) some BUGS-language program but I think I have never seen one.

 

Best regards  -- Marc
